extension.summary: Play Party Mode from your Playarr music video library
extension.description: A deliberately minimal, streaming-first Kodi front-end for Playarr, the self-hosted music video manager. It does one thing — play Party Mode — in Theatre (video over a scrolling artwork wall, composited on the server) or Fullscreen (native decode). It shows a read-only summary of the server's exclusions before playing; all library and party settings are managed in Playarr on the server.
